headline: Central Front Shifts as Wardens Press Dead Lands
war_summary: Since the 09:11 edition the strategic picture has tightened around three contested corridors. In Dead Lands the Warden advantage holds at seven bases to four Colonial, with a fresh surge of captures at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow early this morning and casualty rates for both sides accelerating sharply — Warden losses now exceeding 1,180 per hour. Endless Shore remains largely Colonial (nine to one) but the front has heated: 42 base changes in the past day, Colonial casualties climbing to 154 per hour while Warden losses reach 254 per hour, and enlistments rising on both sides. Farranac Coast shows a similar flare, 18 ownership flips yesterday and casualty rates spiking to 197 Colonial and 228 Warden per hour, with enlistments climbing on both factions. Marban Hollow entered the fight today, recording 15 captures since 10:01 and casualty rates accelerating above 130 per hour for each side. The Fingers remain evenly split (four Colonial, three Warden) after two Colonial captures overnight, and casualty rates there have jumped above 100 per hour for both armies. Drowned Vale stays a Colonial stronghold (12‑0) but activity has quieted, with no captures in the last six hours and casualty rates flat. Enlistments are rising in Dead Lands, Farranac Coast and Marban Hollow, signalling fresh reinforcements at the hottest sectors, while they cool on Drowned Vale and Endless Shore.
